## About
Old Speed works on air cooled VWs. Owner Russell Ludwig got his start working out of his garage, and some customers have been coming to him ever since.
We've done full work on old buses, from motors and transmissions to disc brakes and IRS conversions. We also design and build our own parts, made to last.
You may have seen us in Hot VW's, VW Trends and VW Custom & Classic magazines. Customers rate us 4.9 from 50 Google reviews, and many mention that Russ takes time to share tips and advice.

## Services
- Volkswagen repair: Repair and service for vintage VWs, done by people who know them well.
- Bus motor, transmission and four-wheel disc work: New motor, transmission, four-wheel disc and IRS conversion work for VW buses.
- Brake kits: Brake kits put together by a shop that knows these cars.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on old VW buses?
A: Yes. We've brought vintage buses back to life, from motor and transmission work to brakes.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're at 7311-A Madison Street in Paramount.
